# Monarch Softwares

> Monarch Softwares is a company based in Kovilpalayam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India that unifies IT, HR and marketing into one growth engine: software development, digital marketing, and talent / training services delivered by one team.

Monarch Softwares combines IT solutions, digital marketing and talent services into a single, unified strategy so businesses can focus on building their business instead of managing multiple vendors for development, marketing and hiring.

Contact: contact@monarchsoftwares.com · +91 63857 53874 · WhatsApp: https://wa.me/916385753874
Social: https://www.linkedin.com/company/monarchsoftwares · https://www.instagram.com/monarchsoftwares/

## Services

- [IT Services & Software Development](https://monarchsoftwares.com/it-services): Custom web and mobile app development, AI/ML solutions, cloud infrastructure and enterprise systems. Includes an FAQ section.
- [Digital Marketing Services](https://monarchsoftwares.com/digital-marketing): SEO, PPC, social media, content marketing and creative branding. Includes an FAQ section.
- [Corporate Training & Trainer Deployment](https://monarchsoftwares.com/corporate-training): Customized corporate training programs and on-demand trainers for colleges and firms. Includes an FAQ section.
- [IT Training & Placement Support](https://monarchsoftwares.com/training-placement): IT skills training for freshers and professionals, plus placement support that matches trained candidates to hiring needs. Includes an FAQ section.
